Definition: of Hebrew origin (H6886); Sarepta (i.e. Tsarephath), a place in Palestine:--Sarepta.
BiblicalUsage: Sarepta is the Sidonian town where Jesus says Elias was sent. He was sent not to any widow in Israel, but unto Sarepta, unto a woman that was a widow, in the days of famine.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sarepta matters because God sent His prophet outside Israel to a Gentile widow, and she was fed while Israel went hungry. His mercy was never fenced in by borders.
